mentions.name: Chimera
mentions.description: Chimera is a set of GTK applications that let people manage MergerFS storage pools and LUKS-encrypted hard drives without sysadmin knowledge. It automates disk unlocking and mounting, handles data migration when removing a disk from the pool, and plans to add rclone-based backups to services like Backblaze, AWS, or remote servers. Distribution via RPMs, DEBs, and Python is planned.
mentions.problem: RAID requires capable SATA hardware, specific-sized drives, and array-management skills, and layered LUKS+LVM setups make unrecovered IO errors very difficult to recover from. MergerFS with per-disk LUKS keeps failures isolated to a single disk, but managing it still takes expertise.
mentions.audience: People who want to manage encrypted multi-drive storage pools without being sysadmins.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been making GTK applications so that people can manage MergerFS and LUKS encrypted hard drives without knowing how to be a sysadmin.
